name: Password Reset Then Logon, Same Account
description: An administrative password reset (4724) followed by a logon (4624) for the SAME account. The ordering-only version of this rule pairs a reset with whichever logon happened next, which on a busy domain controller is usually an unrelated account; matching on target_user establishes that the account whose password was reset is the account that then logged on. That is the sequence behind an account takeover, and also behind an entirely ordinary helpdesk call — the pairing is a lead, not a conclusion.
